paper_disjoint.description: Construction and evaluation use disjoint normalized keyword sets.

historical_shared.description: Construction and evaluation use the identical ordered workload; records the workload-fitting protocol.

seeds.note: Explicit release seeds; record the effective seed with each run.

subsets.remapping: same source_object_ids for every method within a fraction; dense local IDs

measurement.timing: materialize and destroy complete answer IDs; no input parsing, verification, logging or IO
measurement.correctness: compare full sorted IDs to independent postings AND before timing
measurement.size: report serialized bytes, logical payload bytes and peak RSS separately; bytes/1e6=MB, bytes/2**20=MiB
measurement.estimated_rows: never combine with measured latency/build speedup

paper_claim.generator: 2-4 title-co-occurring terms; length probabilities 0.5/0.3/0.2; weight f(q)^0.5

historical_shared.generator: Ten reconstructed CS keyword groups, 2000 unique queries each, length uniform 2..10; frequency-weighted terms without replacement. All 20000 rows used for both construction and evaluation.

DBLP.preprocessing: lowercase [a-z0-9]+; unique tokens per object/query; source order retained

paper_claim.generator: 10000 construction and 10000 evaluation queries from 1010916 available records

historical_shared.generator: 1000 query IDs selected without replacement from sorted available IDs; seed 42; normalized lowercase [a-z0-9]+ keyword sets; the same 1000 used for construction and evaluation.

MARCO.preprocessing: lowercase [a-z0-9]+; unique tokens per object/query; source order retained

paper_claim.generator: 2000 distinct co-occurring conjunctions; 1000 construction and 1000 evaluation

historical_shared.generator: 1000 existing ir_datasets_workload.csv queries, not newly generated 2000 conjunctions; same rows for construction and evaluation.

SciDocs.preprocessing: lowercase [a-z0-9]+; unique tokens per object/query; source order retained

paper_claim.generator: 50 topics of 200 terms; 90 distinct within-topic + 10 outside-topic terms/object; query topic Zipf(1.1); 2..10 distinct terms; 10000/10000 disjoint

historical_shared.generator: 100 uniform distinct terms/object; object seed 42; 1000 queries, length uniform 2..10, rounded Normal(5000,100) term IDs with rejection outside vocabulary and within-query deduplication; query seed 43.

SYN.preprocessing: lowercase [a-z0-9]+; unique tokens per object/query; source order retained

paper_claim.generator: Page-title keyword sets; sample 20000 queries containing at least two distinct keywords from March 1-15, 2006; 10000 construction and 10000 evaluation

AOL.preprocessing: Lowercase keyword sets extracted from page titles; at least two distinct keywords per query

baselines.name: Bitmap
baselines.implementation_details: Flat bitmap AND with complete result enumeration; measured and analytic records use distinct measurement kinds.

baselines.name: Roaring
baselines.command_adapter: suite_author_{rank} DATA_DIR METHOD OUTPUT_JSON parameter k c
baselines.implementation_details: 16-bit chunks; runOptimize enabled; portable serialized payload accounting.

baselines.name: TEB
baselines.implementation: author reader/rank/skip + local sparse BFS constructor
baselines.command_adapter: suite_author_{rank} DATA_DIR METHOD OUTPUT_JSON parameter k c
baselines.implementation_details: Author serialized reader, rank and skip iterator; local sparse BFS construction profile.

baselines.name: BigSet
baselines.implementation: local signature bitmap and sparse physical buckets
baselines.command_adapter: suite_author_{rank} DATA_DIR METHOD OUTPUT_JSON parameter k c
baselines.implementation_details: Signature bitmap, sparse physical buckets and posting-list cutoff 32; declared local parameter grid.

baselines.name: MILC
baselines.implementation: local bounded partition DP + offset packing
baselines.command_adapter: suite_author_{rank} DATA_DIR METHOD OUTPUT_JSON parameter k c
baselines.implementation_details: Core profile: bounded partition DP, base-relative offset packing and scalar membership.

baselines.name: Bitlist
baselines.command_adapter: suite_author_{rank} DATA_DIR METHOD OUTPUT_JSON parameter k c
baselines.implementation_details: Base profile: fixed-width block pairs and bitmap AND, preserving input object order.

dp.description: Minimum over retained child states, not all feasible configurations; no global-optimality guarantee.
